name: Rengai Zettari
age: ~20s per the card (Identity, wiki/Volume I — Character Cards/Rengai Zettari.md:23), Dougou Zettari's direct son. Young by the number but not by the writing — the card frames his defining trait as patience that risks tipping into inaction (card, Flaw, line 112), and the prose gives him a father he's already outlived in temperament: a knee that cracks 'the way it always did lately' at only six years into fatherhood (scenes/Rengai_Farewell_and_Dhaerin.md:7) and a voice that 'slows further' rather than spikes under stress (card, Voice, line 115). Cast a hardened man in his mid-to-late twenties who reads older than his years, not a boy soldier.
body: 6'0", lean and wiry — attrition-fighter frame, dense where it counts (card, Description, wiki/Volume I — Character Cards/Rengai Zettari.md:106). Heat-scarred at jaw, neck and hands, knuckles permanently ash-stained (card line 108). His father Dougou is 'the Iron Bison' and built from raw output; Rengai is explicitly the leaner counter-instrument — 'His power is ash because his father is fire. He is what remains after the burn' (card line 96) — endurance and attrition rather than bulk or boom. Cast the wiry attrition fighter, not his father's mass and not a giant's rumble.
texture: faint smoke-cured rasp from lifelong ash exposure
flattens and hardens rather than rises when truly angry
a rare low tenderness reserved for his own house
energy: Restrained and banked at baseline. Facing the man who has been the target of his whole journey, 'Rengai did not answer immediately [...] when he finally spoke his voice carried none of the heat Dhaerin had expected to hear in it' (scenes/Cozbi_Rengai_Dhaerin_Confrontation.md:13). When anger does surface, it shows as pressure, not projection: '"You made a two-year-old bleed for it," Rengai said, and this time the heat did show, banked but visible, ash lifting faintly off his shoulders' (scenes/Cozbi_Rengai_Dhaerin_Confrontation.md:31). The card states the counterintuitive direction directly — under stress he 'slows further' rather than speeding up (card, Voice, line 115) — so tension should read as the voice getting quieter and more deliberate, never rushed. The one register he lowers all the way, rather than banks, is for his wife and son: 'Rengai's voice softened all the way down, the register he used only in this house, for these two people' (scenes/Rengai_Farewell_and_Dhaerin.md:23).
register: Dry, sardonic, rarely loud, lets silence work (card, Voice, wiki/Volume I — Character Cards/Rengai Zettari.md:115) — he is repeatedly shown not answering immediately, working his jaw before letting words out clean (scenes/Cozbi_Rengai_Dhaerin_Confrontation.md:13,15). The numbers back a plainspoken adult who finishes his sentences rather than clips them or interrogates: mean utterance 31.9 words, zero short-share, contractions high at 0.9, first person heavy at 0.6, zero imperatives across his sample (build/book_tools.py voice_fingerprints) — he states his position in full, unhurried clauses. He drops flat and unornamented when naming a technique, 'the way his father said it' (scenes/Cozbi_vs_Rengai_Dhaerin_Combat.md:7), and reserves genuine warmth, low and quiet, for the one house that's his (scenes/Rengai_Farewell_and_Dhaerin.md:15,23). Dry humor surfaces without heat even toward people he respects: '"Insufferable old man," he muttered, though there was no heat left in it' (scenes/Rengai_Farewell_and_Dhaerin.md:53).

evidence.quote: Dry. Sardonic. Rarely loud. Lets silence work. Relaxed in ways that read wrong — stillness that functions as readiness. Under stress: slows further. Red eye brightens. Field thickens. The ash escalates for him
6'0", lean and wiry — attrition-fighter frame, dense where it counts.
His power is ash because his father is fire. He is what remains after the burn.
Aura: the air near him is drier than it should be. Eyes want to blink more often.
Rengai did not answer immediately. [...] when he finally spoke his voice carried none of the heat Dhaerin had expected to hear in it.
"You made a two-year-old bleed for it," Rengai said, and this time the heat did show, banked but visible, ash lifting faintly off his shoulders in the cooling evening air.
"Little man." His voice came out rougher than he meant it to.
He kept his voice low, level, the register he used when a thing was true and did not need volume to make it truer.
Rengai's voice softened all the way down, the register he used only in this house, for these two people.
"Insufferable old man," he muttered, though there was no heat left in it, only the specific fondness reserved for people who were usually right and never let you forget it.
He said the name the way his father said it, flat, unornamented, a fact rather than a boast, and his skin lit from beneath with a dull, banked glow.

reference_direction: Male, medium-low pitch, mid-to-late twenties but weathered — dry, sardonic, deliberately unhurried delivery that gets slower and quieter rather than louder or faster under real pressure. A faint smoke-cured rasp and dryness sit under the voice at all times (lifelong ash and cinder exposure, documented Cinder Lung risk and blood-flecked breath at cost), thickening slightly when he's been fighting hard. Volume almost never rises — anger reads as a flattening and hardening of tone, heat banked rather than shouted, breaking only into a rare low warmth at home with his wife and son. No regional accent flavour on record; closest comparison is a weary attrition soldier delivering a quiet field report he's given too many times before — economical, dry-humored, never needing to raise his voice to be believed.
one_line: A dry, sardonic, smoke-cured baritone that gets quieter and slower exactly when the fight gets worse — banked heat instead of shouting, with a rare low tenderness kept only for his own house.
